title: SRR0-P0 Gate 4 — target compute headroom (FasterGSFused preprocess_backward)

identity.remote_guard: EPIC-05 only; no CUDA on local Windows

method.description: Behavior-inert: loads frozen checkpoint, zero-initializes Adam moments (exact training_setup allocation), runs native forward+backward on one real training view, profiles per-kernel CUDA self time with torch.profiler; separately measures async steady-state throughput and CUDA-event GPU-stream time. NO kernel change, NO training-semantics change, NO checkpoint mutation.
method.config: copies at /root/srr0_configs with GPU_INDICES:[0]; originals hardcode [2]; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=5/6/7 remap; 3 scenes parallel on GPUs 5/6/7
method.recompute_target: preprocess_backward_cu — recomputes SH direction/basis, camera projection, variance=exp(2*raw_scale), R=quat->rot, 3D covariance/RSS, EWA Jacobian/2D covariance

diagnosis.evidence: GPU-stream (event) time 139.7/146.2/145.2 ms vs busy GPU compute 36.6/55.5/50.8 ms => ~74% of GPU stream is idle gaps between kernels (launch latency). async steady-state (130/148/131 ms) ~= sync wall (124/134/124 ms) >> busy compute. The iteration is CPU/launch-bound; the wall-vs-GPU gap is REAL, not a per-iter-sync artifact.
diagnosis.implication: preprocess_backward recompute (1.4/6.2/3.6 ms) is hidden under launch overhead. Removing it cannot reduce E2E time unless it was on the critical path, which the launch-bound profile contradicts for the busy-compute-only denominator.

gate4_summary.requirement: affected recomputation cost optimistic E2E ceiling >= 1.04x in >= 2/3 scenes
gate4_summary.result: only garden reaches 1.04x (1.044x async / 1.048x wall); room (1.011x) and bicycle (1.028x) fail under every valid E2E denominator. 1/3 < 2/3.
gate4_summary.note_on_invalid_denominator: The busy-GPU-compute denominator (36.6/55.5/50.8 ms) yields ceilings 1.04/1.13/1.08 (all pass) but is INVALID: it assumes zero inter-kernel gaps, disproven by the event/async measurement showing the GPU idle ~74% of the stream. E2E ceiling must be measured against actual per-iteration time, not summed kernel busy-time.
